purpose: Describe the selected vehicle's departure routines using returned drive starts, with explicit evidence accounting and model limitations.
primaryGoal: Find supported upcoming local-hour windows and understand how much observed history supports the modeled likelihood, without scheduling or commanding the vehicle.

dataSources.contract: Key drivingKeys.history(vehicleId, boundedLimit); enabled only for a selected vehicle; request receives AbortSignal; MODERATE stale time; safeArray selection; no pagination, range parameters, or periodic refresh here.
dataSources.limits: Backend handler/repository behavior and real response ordering were not inspected or exercised. The hook documents a 1000-row server cap; the UI describes returned rows rather than lifetime coverage.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace vehicle selection and timezone infrastructure
dataSources.contract: No local vehicle selector; selected ID scopes the drive request and vehicle timezone scopes model/calendar labels. useTimezone implementation and its ancillary requests were not traced.
dataSources.workspace: web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:23-78 does not register /departure-forecast for range; the vehicle-disabled sets also do not exclude it. Preserve shared vehicle ownership and the independent fixed 120-day training window; do not add an inert range control or silently retrain the model on workspace range.

dataSources.hook: forecastDepartures(drives, frozen nowMs, vehicle timezone, { historyLimit: 1000 })
dataSources.contract: Injected frozen clock; recorded drive start is one event; default 120-day lookback, 24 real local-hour boundaries, Gamma-Poisson estimates, descriptive evidence support, supported-only peaks/ranking, illustrative planning marker. Millisecond calendar instants are internal model values, not new physical-unit API fields.

fatalError and refreshError remain distinct. Cached data survives refresh failure; paused/offline retained data gets StaleRefreshWarning. PageLayout receives the original query for freshness metadata.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer / Grid
components.contract: PageLayout delegates PageContainer props and uses full-width min-w-0 container. PageContainer owns header, query freshness, operational mode and announcements. Grid uses one column below xl and two at xl for the two paired rows.

components.name: DepartureEvidenceBrief / DrivingSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Six typed StatMetric measurements adapted through useOperationalMetrics; localized context, source provenance, missing reasons, retained/loading state. Do not restore the alternate MetricCard KPI grid.

components.name: ChartContainer / EmbeddedChart
components.contract: Panel/embedded variants; loading/error/empty/onRetry; responsive size/height/mobileHeight/fluid; chartKey and hidden-series provider; localized ariaLabel/description, fallback data/dataColumns, image export and explicit exportData CSV. EmbeddedChart delegates to the same owner, not a separate chart engine.

components.name: GlassPanel / PanelTitle / Heading / Text / Badge / Button
components.contract: Shared surface and typography roles, semantic badges and named retry button; current page has no raw interactive HTML controls.

components.name: DepartureForecastSectionBody / DepartureForecastQueryStatus
components.contract: Page-specific passive repeated placeholders plus one actionable source status. Evidence quality permits resolved empty accounting; methodology stays visible independently of query results.

components.name: StaleRefreshWarning / QueryError / EmptyState / Skeleton / AlertBanner / FadeIn
components.owner: Existing feedback and motion category owners
components.contract: Preserve retained content and retry, localized passive states and one loading status. FadeIn implementation/reduced-motion behavior was not independently exercised.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / MDC-034 single chart interaction owner
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Next24Chart already supplies a panel ChartContainer and six-column evidence table; Next24Plot mounts another ChartContainer through EmbeddedChart, with a different chartKey and a three-column table. Its inner context takes precedence over the externally passed state at line 94.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one existing chart frame/provider and one complete evidence table per logical next-24 chart. Preserve legend state and both existing URL identities with an explicit integration decision; do not silently drop saved links or evidence columns.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The accounting/coverage/support groups render preformatted label/value cards separately from the shared operational metrics pipeline. This is specialist presentation, not proof that all fields can be safely replaced by generic metrics.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Evaluate existing StatGroup support with the stats owner before any adoption; preserve all 22 entries, three groups, missing values, unrounded specialist semantics and resolved-zero row counts.

sourceObservations: Two paired page grids stack until xl; weekday routines use sm two-column reflow; methodology uses md two and xl three columns.
Heatmap deliberately contains a 58rem minimum-width matrix inside overflow-auto rather than deleting weekday/hour cells.
Hour-distribution dayparts reflow from two to four columns; fixed chart heights include explanatory content.

issues.rule: MDC-043 mobile reachability and long-content preservation
issues.detail: Each ranked row is an unwrapped horizontal flex group containing rank, localized datetime/evidence, and modeled-percentage badge. There is no small-width stacked variant; long badge text can squeeze the central content. This is a source-identified risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Keep all rank/time/evidence/likelihood fields and adopt a small-width stacked or wrapping row while retaining desktop alignment. Exercise 320px, long locale strings, RTL and 200% text before acceptance.

sourceObservations: Chart frames have explicit ariaLabel, descriptions and evidence tables; heatmap presentation is aria-hidden while its owner supplies a 168-cell fallback dataset.
Retry uses the shared Button; ranked windows use ol/li; evidence metrics use dl/dt/dd; decorative icons generally have aria-hidden.
QueryStatus has one labeled loading live status and separate fatal/refresh recovery surfaces.

issues.detail: Per-cell modeled likelihood, departures and occurrences are exposed visually through a native title on a nonfocusable div inside aria-hidden content. The shared fallback table supplies assistive/forced-colors access, but the grid itself has no explicit keyboard/touch disclosure of that detail.
issues.fix: Retain the complete fallback table and assess a shared chart table/disclosure affordance or accessible non-hover cell-detail pattern. Avoid 168 gratuitous tab stops; verify touch, keyboard and screen-reader paths before calling this resolved.

issues.detail: The inner chart's fallback accessible name says cumulative probability, while the model and outer frame explicitly state modeled likelihood is not a calibrated probability.
issues.fix: Use the existing localized modeled-likelihood terminology consistently for the inner frame or remove redundant framing through the single-owner integration. Keep the calibration disclaimer accessible.

sourceConfirmed.noVehicle: Passive section bodies and central select-vehicle message; no request enabled.
sourceConfirmed.initialLoading: Six summary measurements remain unknown with waiting explanations; section skeletons and one live loading status.
sourceConfirmed.fatalError: Shared QueryError retry once in QueryStatus; persistent section shells and methodology.
sourceConfirmed.refreshError: Retained historical evidence stays visible; central warning and retry; brief labels retained evidence.
sourceConfirmed.pausedOfflineWithData: StaleRefreshWarning above retained sections with shared recovery.
sourceConfirmed.empty: No prior-only summary peak/horizon/marker; section placeholders; quality accounting remains present via allowEmpty.
sourceConfirmed.noQualifyingStarts: Distinct message for returned rows with no valid starts in the lookback.
sourceConfirmed.thinEvidence: Descriptive estimates and explicit support warning; no planning marker.
sourceConfirmed.historyCapReached: Summary, ranked-window and quality disclaimers retain capped-history meaning.
sourceConfirmed.unsupportedWeekdays: Explicit unsupported weekdays/cells, never prior-only learned routines.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-034 shared frame state fidelity
issues.detail: The chart wrappers gate their child content and exportable/data, but do not pass loading, empty, error or onRetry into ChartContainer. The shared owner derives data-chart-state and aria-busy from those props (ChartContainer.tsx:487-492), so frames remain classified ready during unresolved/loading/fatal/empty source states. Heatmap, hourly distribution and weekly trend repeat the pattern.
issues.fix: Coordinate the existing frame state API with the page's passive placeholder strategy; expose truthful busy/unavailable state without hiding shells, creating repeated live announcements/retry controls, or replacing retained data on refresh failure.

visualIssues.detail: Four supported-cell intensity bands hardcode cyan border/background colors while unsupported cells use neutral tokens. This bypasses selected chart/theme accent ownership; it is not evidence of measured contrast failure or neon text.
visualIssues.fix: Use a reviewed restrained sequential chart/semantic palette with subdued neutral boundaries, preserving supported/unsupported distinction, numeric counts and intensity ordering. Retain saved theme and explicit user chart-palette choices.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-016 hierarchy over decorative hue
visualIssues.detail: Every methodology article's title/icon row inherits fixed text-cyan-300, and quality/ranked/weekday titles repeat cyan icon decoration. Typography and panel surfaces otherwise use shared roles and semantic variables.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing muted/secondary semantic text/icon tokens for explanatory headings, reserving semantic hue for evidence meaning. No new page palette, glow or per-card accent system.

architectureIssues.detail: The active brief derives its Props via ComponentProps of the alternate DepartureForecastKpiBand presentation, even though that component is not mounted by this page. A presentation implementation therefore owns the new brief's type contract.
architectureIssues.fix: In a later assigned source change, place the forecast/state/locale/timeZone props with existing departure-domain types and let both presenters consume that contract; do not resurrect the alternate KPI grid or change model behavior.

priority.rationale: The page already preserves its nine sections, modeled-data caveats, shared workspace vehicle scope and retained trust. Address competing chart controllers and truthful frame/accessibility semantics before restrained palette polish.
order: truthful chart source states and accessible terminology
